reviewer: Codex child agent credibility_cs_finite; independent byte comparisons for the archival operation. This is AI source-preservation review, not a new mathematical proof or human peer review.

comparison_method.baseline: Raw Git blob bytes resolved from git ls-tree at the fixed baseline commit, obtained with git cat-file --batch.
comparison_method.current: Path.read_bytes from the current worktree; no Git text conversion or normalization.
comparison_method.hash: SHA-256 for both baseline and current bytes; direct byte equality is also tested.
comparison_method.concurrent_change_guard: Protected working files read and hashed a second time before the report is written.
comparison_method.original_files_only: Files already tracked in the specified baseline define protected historical sets. Newly added material is separate and cannot replace an original file.

commands: git cat-file --batch (baseline blob object IDs on stdin; output consumed as bytes)
python -X utf8 - (inline hashlib/pathlib byte comparison, exact README section extraction, and JSON report writing)

protected_scopes.lean: Every baseline routes/qrh/lean/ file: all 241 .lean source files and three build configuration files.
protected_scopes.code: Every baseline routes/qrh/code/ file, including all .py/.ps1 and requirements.txt; new build_reading_map.py is not an original core file.
protected_scopes.historical_audit: Every baseline routes/qrh/audit/ file except its navigation README.md.
protected_scopes.traditional: Every baseline routes/traditional/ file plus empty tracked-diff and nonignored-untracked/status checks.
protected_scopes.root_readmes: Raw traditional Track/Route A block in each root README; surrounding current QRH/navigation text may change.

traditional_git_check.ignored_artifacts: Not claimed to compare ignored environment/cache directories; no baseline tracked traditional file is excluded.

root_traditional_sections.scope: Start of Track/Route A heading through immediately before Track/Route B heading; raw bytes including whitespace and line endings.
